chapter: Boyhood scene: halls and dance music
title: Babies in the check room at the balls
summary: He recalls his mother taking him to balls, where old women minded checked babies in the check room.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Go ahead, it's ready Danny on the second reel.

Yeah, I will. I think a few years back, there was a lot of talk around here about the people having babysitters, you know, getting teenage babysitters. Well, I remember when they had the bonkers and the balls, and I'd go there with my family, my mother would take me some time. My mother was a very small kid, and she'd take me to these dance halls, and these different bands, and these social affairs she'd do. And in the check rooms, people would check their babies, it's like you check your hats and coats, you know. There's always some old elderly person, particularly an old woman who would be in the check room, and if a young woman came to the ball, and she brought her baby, who was still in arms, she'd wrapped him up well, and she handed them to the old lady, tip the old lady, and the old lady would lay the kid down up back in the room there. Well, there would be five or six other kids laying around there. And the kids start bawling and start crying, she had a little, make up a little concoction, I think, a little tawty like, you know, put a little fire water in it, you know, and the kid would soon go to sleep.
Just like a Fae Do Do Do, huh? Like the Cajuns there. That's right, and if the, and when the dance was over,

all the girls, the young woman, or the woman, go to check room and get our, get our happy coat, or the hat with the women, or coat, and also get our kid. But there was no problem to leave, like, leaving your kid home, because all the check room attendants was, that was part of their job,
